subject: SORT statement
notes: kb/Work PB995. cite.py --check 14.9.40.3 'the file description entry for file-name-1 shall describe neither records smaller than the smallest record nor larger than the largest record described for file-name-3' -> OK §14.9.40.3 11). The same screen with the roles exchanged: the GIVING file's description bounds the SD's records. The note's repro (SD X(5), GIVING RECORD VARYING IN SIZE FROM 1 TO 2) is refused, as are a fixed 3-byte GIVING file and a variable GIVING file whose smallest record exceeds the SD's smallest; equal sizes and containing ranges are legal.
